comment:
I went for "Use AI to make Buckets, but no AI features in the app", on the trust that you won't put yourself in a situation where you don't understand the codebase. 

Just to articulate a resistance to AI features: I don't know what those features would be for, and if I can't articulate a use case, then I don't want them in there. I am open to the idea that there is some killer AI feature that would win me over. If you had some idea of what those would be, then it would maybe help people make a decision on how they feel.
